summary:
Everything below was measured with read-only probes run against the installed MSYS2 stack (GTK 3.24.52, GLib 2.90.1, Pango 1.58.2, gdk-pixbuf 2.44.8). Only a few points come from knowledge of the GDK source, and the spec labels them.

1. **The CSS build step fails on this machine.** tools/css_to_gtk.py reads and writes text using the locale encoding, which is cp1254 here (MSYS2 Python 3.14 runs with utf8_mode=0). index.html then fails to decode. Fix: explicit utf-8 with LF line endings, run with -X utf8 -B, and pin the Python interpreter. With that fix it produces 31 sources and 1572 rules, and the output has no font-family and no non-ASCII. Ninja 1.13 handles the non-ASCII design path.

2. **Fonts (decision D5 is confirmed).**
   - Pango uses DirectWrite, so the Fontconfig calls do nothing.
   - The TTF is loaded with pango_font_map_add_font_file in a new radios_ui_register_app_font. Its family name is "Inter Variable Text".
   - Fontconfig is never initialised at runtime, so no fonts.conf is needed.
   - Inter lacks 15 symbols used in UI strings (for example ▾ ⏭ ⚙ ✕). With the current font list they show as boxes and the line height grows by 5 px.
   - The new family list "Inter Variable Text, Inter Variable, Inter, Segoe UI Symbol, Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI, Nirmala UI, sans-serif" leaves 0 missing glyphs, including track titles in Hebrew, Arabic, CJK, Hindi and emoji.
   - Drawn text that uses Pango "Sans N" moves to the same list at fixed pixel sizes. Text drawn with cairo's simple text API ends up in Arial. `monospace` resolves to Courier New, so it becomes Cascadia Mono/Consolas.

3. **Exact runtime file list.**
   - The GTK DLL dependency set is 48 DLLs (44.7 MB); the whole app is 123 DLLs (184 MB, most of it FFmpeg).
   - Only the SVG image loader is needed, because PNG, JPEG and the other formats are built into gdk-pixbuf. Its loaders.cache must end with a blank line, otherwise SVG support silently disappears.
   - Four compiled GTK settings schemas are required. Without them, merely creating a file-chooser button aborts the process.
   - Icon themes: Adwaita without its cursors folder, plus AdwaitaLegacy and the hicolor index. Without hicolor every missing icon is a warning, which is fatal in tests.
   - Also bundled: Turkish .mo files and a settings.ini.

4. **Environment and DLL search.**
   - Default lookup puts C:\ProgramData and Public Documents ahead of the bundle, and user variables (GTK_THEME, GTK_CSD, PANGOCAIRO_BACKEND and others) leak in. A new step before gtk_init pins XDG_DATA_DIRS, XDG_CONFIG_DIRS, GDK_PIXBUF_MODULE_FILE and LANGUAGE=tr, and checks that the runtime files exist.
   - SetDefaultDllDirectories breaks the SVG loader in dev/test runs. AddDllDirectory on the GLib DLL folder fixes it; I confirmed both.

5. **GTK settings must be set in code.** settings.ini cannot override the values Windows supplies, and user ini files override ours. The error bell is turned off because it calls MessageBeep on the default audio device, which may be the on-air output.

6. **Title bars and dialogs.** No client-side decorations are used anywhere. A new hook makes title bars dark through DWM (S_OK on build 26300).

7. **HiDPI.** GDK uses whole-number scaling only. At 125–175 % the pixel-based UI renders at 100 % physical size while point-based text grows. The spec documents this, converts drawn text to pixel sizes, and adds an optional GDK_SCALE override.

8. **File choosers.** Filter matching is case-insensitive on Windows. MIME rules never match and push the file-chooser buttons off the native Windows dialog, so the filters become pattern-only. The GTK file dialogs that tests drive stay.

9. **Not present in this codebase:** GtkSocket/GtkPlug, printing, and any X11 code outside content_scale.c. The tests' Xvfb setup and GDK_BACKEND=x11 are replaced by an interactive-desktop check and a Windows GUI test environment.
files_touched: src/ui/widgets.c (shared audio pattern list, optional cairo text helper)
key_decisions: Fonts per D5, verified: ship assets/fonts/InterVariable.ttf and register it with pango_font_map_add_font_file(pango_cairo_font_map_get_default()) in a new radios_ui_register_app_font(assets_root, &error) in radios_ui (not radios_core, so radios_core does not need Pango); keep the 'Tasarımın Inter fontu yüklenemedi' startup failure; remove the Fc* calls, the fontconfig include and link; ship no fonts.conf (fontconfig is never initialised at runtime – probe).

Canonical family list RADIOS_UI_FONT_FAMILIES = 'Inter Variable Text, Inter Variable, Inter, Segoe UI Symbol, Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI, Nirmala UI, sans-serif' for radios.css:4, preferences.c:72 and Pango code. Segoe UI Symbol comes before Segoe UI so symbol glyphs come from a font present on every Windows install. Measured: 0 unknown glyphs for all UI symbols and multi-script metadata.

Drawing-code fonts: routing_graph_ui 'Inter, Sans' and Pango 'Sans 10'/'Sans 8' become radios_ui_font_description_new(px, weight) with absolute pixel sizes (13.333/10.667), so drawn labels keep the Linux 96-dpi look and do not grow with DPI. cairo simple-API (toy) text is optional to migrate (it renders in Arial). monospace becomes 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas.

Bundle only the SVG pixbuf loader (png/jpeg/gif/bmp/ico/tiff are built into gdk-pixbuf 2.44.8). Ship an exact relative loaders.cache that ends with a blank line, and check at startup that the 'svg' format is present.

Ship Adwaita without its cursors folder (Windows system cursors stay; all cursor names resolve), AdwaitaLegacy, and the hicolor index.theme. Regenerate icon caches as the last staging step; a stale cache only costs speed.

Ship the 4 compiled org.gtk.Settings.* schemas (FileChooser, ColorChooser, EmojiChooser, Debug) – mandatory, since GtkFileChooserButton construction aborts without them. Tests use GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory; the product uses the registry backend.

Important GtkSettings are set in code with g_object_set (APPLICATION source): prefer-dark TRUE, error-bell FALSE (MessageBeep reaches the default audio device), event sounds off, dialogs-use-header FALSE, icon theme Adwaita, and theme Adwaita unless Windows high contrast is active. etc/gtk-3.0/settings.ini only mirrors these values, because settings.ini cannot override values Windows supplies and later ini files override ours.

New radios_ui_runtime_prepare_environment(), run before gtk_init: find the GTK prefix from the location of libgtk-3-0.dll; unset the risky GTK_*/GIO_*/PANGOCAIRO_BACKEND/FONTCONFIG_* variables (RADIOS_GTK_KEEP_ENV=1 keeps them); set XDG_DATA_DIRS=<prefix>\share, XDG_CONFIG_DIRS=<prefix>\etc and GDK_PIXBUF_MODULE_FILE; set LANGUAGE=tr unless already set; fail fast with a Turkish message when runtime files are missing. radios_ui_runtime_init() runs after gtk_init and does font registration, settings, self-checks and the dark-title-bar realize hook.
Dark Windows title bars: DwmSetWindowAttribute (dark mode attribute 20, falling back to 19; caption, text and border colours) on every TOPLEVEL GtkWindow from a realize emission hook; -ldwmapi.

File choosers: keep GtkFileChooserDialog (tests drive them by widget name). Remove the dead mime rules ('audio/*', 'application/xml') and use a shared pattern list, so every GtkFileChooserButton uses the native IFileDialog. Pattern matching is case-insensitive on Win32 (probe).

HiDPI: keep the PerMonitorV2 manifest. GDK scales in whole numbers only, so at 125–175 % the UI is drawn at 100 % physical size; document it and offer an optional [ui] gdk_scale override. Do not auto-change content_scale_percent.
CSS generator: explicit encoding='utf-8', newline='\n' plus -X utf8 -B in the CMake custom command, Python3_EXECUTABLE pinned to the MSYS2 interpreter (Python3_FIND_REGISTRY NEVER).

Runtime staging: compute DLL dependencies at staging time (CMake file(GET_RUNTIME_DEPENDENCIES) with objdump) instead of hard-coding them. Include the gspawn helpers; never gdbus.exe, the build-time tools, the other pixbuf loaders, share/themes or etc/fonts.
risks: PerMonitorV2 with GTK 3.24 on mixed-DPI multi-monitor setups is not well exercised (GDK by itself only requests system-DPI awareness). It needs manual verification; the fallback is a system-aware manifest.

At 125–175 % display scaling the whole pixel-based UI renders at 100 % physical size, while point-based GTK text (menus, tooltips) grows, so sizes are mixed. This needs a product decision or documentation; the optional DPI text factor needs lead approval.

Runtime file problems fail in different ways: missing schemas abort the process; a missing or malformed loaders.cache silently removes all symbolic icons; a missing hicolor theme produces warnings that are fatal in tests. Startup self-checks and the bundle test are required.
Dev/test runs break SVG icons unless the platform init code calls AddDllDirectory on the GLib DLL folder after SetDefaultDllDirectories (measured).
The detached mixer starts gtk_window_begin_move_drag on a window created during the same mouse press (dj.c:325,343). This is untested on Win32 and needs manual verification and a fallback.
Bundle size is 184 MB, mostly FFmpeg codec/filter dependencies (x265, aom, shaderc, whisper/ggml). Whether to reduce it is a media/packaging decision.

Some statements come from knowledge of the GDK source and were not probed: AltGr reported as MOD2, DPI-change handling only at whole-number scale changes, the exe icon used for window classes, and which file dialog (native or GTK) GtkFileChooserNative shows.
Labels that contain fallback symbols are 2 px taller (Segoe UI Symbol metrics). Cairo simple-API (toy) text stays Arial unless migrated.
GTK 3 has no screen-reader bridge on Windows, so accessibility regresses compared with Linux.

Function naming overlap: ui-platform-c calls the font function radios_platform_register_app_font; this spec proposes radios_ui_register_app_font in radios_ui. The lead must reconcile the name and who owns the edits to main.c, window.c, preferences.c and content_scale.c.
Icon caches become stale after installer extraction (cache older than the directory). GTK then scans the theme folders: slower start, same behaviour.
cross_area_dependencies: ui-platform-c (main.c, window.c, content_scale.c, preferences.c owner): call order radios_platform_init() -> radios_ui_runtime_prepare_environment() -> option parsing -> gtk_init_check -> radios_ui_runtime_init(assets_root); replace window.c:735,748-751 with radios_ui_register_app_font and drop the fontconfig include at window.c:23; move prefer-dark into runtime init; preferences.c:72 font list plus drag-to-move on the custom title bar; content_scale.c handles Win32 popups synchronously like X11 and divides the tooltip cursor size by the scale factor; clamp the default window size to the monitor work area.

platform layer (D3): after SetDefaultDllDirectories, radios_platform_init must AddDllDirectory(directory of the loaded libglib-2.0-0.dll), and must not add PATH entries; it also provides an interactive-desktop check.

build (CMakeLists): Python3_FIND_REGISTRY NEVER or Python3_EXECUTABLE=C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/python.exe; '-X utf8 -B' in the CSS custom command; remove pkg_check_modules(FONTCONFIG) and its link; add src/ui/ui_runtime.c and -ldwmapi to radios_ui; .rc with icon ID 1, VERSIONINFO and manifest; a GUI test environment without GDK_BACKEND=x11; new CTests gtk_runtime, gtk_runtime_bundle and css_generator_encoding; native_window WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}.

packaging: stage the runtime per spec section 10 (DLL dependencies via objdump, gspawn helpers, pixbufloader_svg.dll plus the exact loaders.cache, the 4 compiled schemas, Adwaita without cursors, AdwaitaLegacy, hicolor index, regenerated icon caches, tr .mo files, settings.ini; no gdbus.exe and no etc/fonts); add .ttf/.ico/.svg to the tools/radios_package.py allow-list; keep the bin/lib/share/etc layout relocatable; keep the already staged runtime\python.

tests area: migrate FcInit/FcConfigAppFontAddFile in test_automation_calendar.c:3045-3046 and test_media_drop_ui.c:775-776 to radios_ui_register_app_font; GUI test executables call the runtime prepare/init functions; tests/gui_env.py provides has_interactive_desktop() and gui_test_environment(); SendInput replacement for XTest in content_scale_test_input.h (ui-platform-c section 15).
media/audio: the shared audio file pattern list (wav mp3 flac ogg opus m4a aac) must match what the decoder/analyzer supports; the FFmpeg dependency set dominates bundle size.
design/assets owner: create assets/icons/radios.svg (paths only, no text) and a multi-size radios.ico.
docs: replace 'Fontconfig ile WOFF2' statements (assets/README.md:5, docs/04-native-tasarim.md:11, docs/02-proje-duzeni.md:31,71, packaging/README.md:27) with the Windows DirectWrite/TTF wording.
platform_api_needs: C: void radios_platform_init(void) – addition: right after SetDefaultDllDirectories(LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DEFAULT_DIRS) and SetDllDirectoryW(L""), call AddDllDirectory() on the directory of GetModuleHandleW(L"libglib-2.0-0.dll") (GetModuleFileNameW, strip the file name, keep the wide string). In the bundle this is the exe folder; in dev/tests it is C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin. Without it, LoadLibraryW of gdk-pixbuf loader modules cannot find librsvg and its dependencies (measured). PATH must never be added.

C: gboolean radios_platform_has_interactive_desktop(void) – TRUE when GetUserObjectInformationW(GetProcessWindowStation(), UOI_FLAGS, &USEROBJECTFLAGS, ...) reports dwFlags & WSF_VISIBLE. main uses it for the 'Yerel ekran açılamadı… etkileşimli Windows masaüstü gerekli' error, and tests use it to skip with exit 77.

C (optional, otherwise use GLib directly): gchar *radios_platform_module_directory(const gchar *module_name) – UTF-8 folder of an already loaded DLL (GetModuleHandleW + GetModuleFileNameW, \\?\ prefix stripped), NULL when not loaded. Used to find the GTK prefix (folder minus a trailing 'bin'), equivalent to g_win32_get_package_installation_directory_of_module(GetModuleHandleW(L"libgtk-3-0.dll")).

Python (tests helper tests/gui_env.py): has_interactive_desktop() -> bool, implemented with ctypes user32.GetProcessWindowStation and GetUserObjectInformationW(UOI_FLAGS=1) and a USEROBJECTFLAGS struct (fInherit, fReserved, dwFlags), WSF_VISIBLE=1.

Python (tests helper): gui_test_environment(tmp: pathlib.Path, base: Mapping[str, str]) -> dict[str, str] – returns base plus G_DEBUG=fatal-warnings, GTK_IM_MODULE=gtk-im-context-simple, GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory, private XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME under tmp and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, with GDK_BACKEND, GTK_THEME, GTK_CSD, PANGOCAIRO_BACKEND, DISPLAY and WAYLAND_DISPLAY removed.
Python (build tool tools/css_to_gtk.py): no shim – explicit encoding='utf-8', newline='\n' on every read_text/write_text and hashlib over source.encode('utf-8').
